description: This Java class 'MeetingDataValidator' provides validation logic for meeting data related to the 'Fineract' project. It checks JSON input for creating, updating, and attendance validation of meetings, ensuring required parameters are present and valid.

classes.name: MeetingDataValidator
classes.description: A Spring component class responsible for validating meeting-related JSON data for create, update, and attendance operations.

methods.name: validateForCreate
methods.description: Validates JSON input for creating a new meeting, checking for required fields and valid attendance details.

methods.name: validateForUpdate
methods.description: Validates JSON input for updating an existing meeting, allowing optional fields but validating provided data.

methods.name: validateForUpdateAttendance
methods.description: Validates JSON input specifically for updating attendance data of a meeting.

methods.name: throwExceptionIfValidationWarningsExist
methods.description: Throws a validation exception if there are any errors accumulated during validation.

methods.name: validateAttendanceDetails
methods.description: Checks attendance details in the JSON input, ensuring each attendance record has valid client IDs and attendance types.
